starturl.description: The initial URL to fetch and display when the application starts.

debuglevel.description: The level of debug output to generate. 0 means no debug output.

proxyhost.description: The hostname or IP address of the HTTP proxy server to use for network requests. Leave empty to use direct connection.

proxyport.description: The port number of the HTTP proxy server. Set to 0 if proxyhost is not used.
